video_title: Is the NBA Too Soft? — Charles Oakley

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on the Knicks' playoff run and James Dolan
quotes.excerpt: It's awesome that the Knicks are in the finals, but I hate how the owner James Dolan treated you.

text_blocks.speaker: Steiny
text_blocks.text: It's awesome that the Knicks are in the finals, but I hate how the owner James Dolan treated you. Can you walk us through how you're feeling about your team that you gave blood, sweat, and tears for in the finals?

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Oakley
text_blocks.text: I'm happy for the fans in New York. They've been waiting for this moment since 99. They're back there. They got a new president, Rose came in there and changed things around. Jalen Brunson signing a free agent from Dallas, that was the biggest win. That's like a championship getting him on that team, what he's been doing over the last three years, all uphill, just putting the team on his back and just being a great leader and a great guy for the city.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on the Knicks' recent playoff success
quotes.excerpt: When you sweep two teams like that, I mean, I don't care how bad they are, but you got something going.
quotes.quote: When you sweep two teams like that, I mean, I don't care how bad they are, but you got something going, you got something clicking, the bench playing well, and Mike Brown and the staff doing a great job with the team.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on Jalen Brunson's leadership and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Brunson is showing that no matter what size you are, when you got skills and understand the game, IQ.
quotes.quote: Brunson is showing that no matter what size you are, when you got skills and understand the game, IQ, and all them guys from Villanova on the team, he got his homies on there and he's real comfortable. He's just been doing a great job for the city of New York.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on players dealing with negative fan criticism
quotes.excerpt: It happens to Jeter, me, whoever else. I mean, that's the part of the business.
quotes.quote: It happens to Jeter, me, whoever else. I mean, that's the part of the business and these guys got to stop being so sensitive. What did he do for the fans to get on his bad side?

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on the lack of physicality in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the league is physical now. They need to get rid of that replay.
quotes.quote: I don't think the league is physical now. They need to get rid of that replay and this and that. If they're going to have all that, they might as well just get to officials. I don't know, the game has changed. It's a new time in life and we got to realize that as we get old things are going to change. The game changed with the three-pointers, I don't like that. They don't have guys that have the high IQ but they get the big money, and I'm glad they're getting the money because they hit that money from us, but they got to pay for less talent.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on the nature of physical play in basketball
quotes.excerpt: When you play hard and physical, hey, I got to tell anybody, if 18 will come out and the Pento go head-to-head, the Pento going backwards.
quotes.quote: When you play hard and physical, hey, I got to tell anybody, if 18 will come out and the Pento go head-to-head, the Pento going backwards. Just how the game is. You got a guard coming in trying to challenge a big guy, he's supposed to go down on the floor. That's not your job. Your job is to stay around the perimeter and not to come to the hole.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on James Harden's playstyle and foul baiting
quotes.excerpt: SGA is a great player, great scorer, but he's just not a great athlete.
quotes.quote: SGA is a great player, great scorer, but he's just not a great athlete. And now that you seen that there's a lot of wings can check him and get into him, and he's got to score, so he's got to do whatever he can to score. Push off. If they let James Harden take two steps backwards, he's taking two steps forward, that's his game, let it go.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on the future of the NBA's aging stars
quotes.excerpt: Long as you got Curry, you got a chance. It's going to come to a time in the NBA with LeBron, KD and Curry.
quotes.quote: Long as you got Curry, you got a chance. It's going to come to a time in the NBA with LeBron, KD and Curry. And now they're on the back nine on number 16 and 17, and who's going to be the next one step up to put them three guys? Who can, what three guys in the NBA from the US can step up like LeBron, KD and Curry? Nobody. But my thing is, Curry's still going to play, LeBron's still going to play, and KD's still going to play. My thing is, you got to be on the right team. You can't be on a play-in team.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley on Victor Wembanyama's emotional reactions
quotes.excerpt: He's young, he's a fresh guy. He's still a factor, he's still the top three best player in the NBA.
quotes.quote: He's young, he's a fresh guy. He's still a factor, he's still the top three best player in the NBA, and you know, so hey, he came in and show hard and he talk up. I like all the stuff he do, so more power to him.

quotes.speaker: Charles Oakley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Oakley's ranking of the greatest Knicks of all time
quotes.excerpt: I'm going with Walt Frazier. If Patrick had a ring I would put him in second.
quotes.quote: I'm going with Walt Frazier. If Patrick had a ring I would put him in second, but well how Brunson put the team on the back, he's big shot and what he doing consistent, I'm putting Brunson number two, Patrick three, and Walt Frazier four.
